Would be cool, but... Wouldn’t this cause a bit of frame drops? Many users (especially VR users) already experience a lot of frame drops from unoptimized avatars and worlds combined. Therefore a particle effect, each time someone leaves or enters the room would only have a negative impact.

author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

comments.value:
Maybe some parameters would suffice.

Something like a bool that returns true whenever the user disconnected. However, this would mean that VRChat would need to keep the avatar enabled for a few seconds after the user left, in-case the avatar does a custom leaving animation.

Since this is something worlds have and can implement themselves, I think this is something that should be up to world developers to implement.

However, maybe the SDK by default should have some nice QoL behaviors like this? It would make worlds feel more alive by default to have things like this. World leave/join effects, default UI page when that comes out, etc. The world creator could override as needed.

I'd love this.

Seeing it finally being marked as "tracked" gives me hope.

It'd be even better if one could customize their leaving animation on their avatar. Some ideas that come to mind include:

-"change da world" style fadeout 

-Tron style de-rezzolution

-Star Trek transporter beam

-Ready Player One style headset removal 

Please note that's just off the top of my head.

Having strict audio and timing limits (e.g. 15 seconds max) would help with keeping the animations from getting obnoxious. A global toggle to turn all of them off (with possibly an exception for friends) would also be good.
sort of like how kingdom hearts does it. I like it.
Some world already implement this and I like it. Just some particles or selectable effect.

details:
I played this game almost a year now and I would love to see some sort of particle effect when someone leaves the room instead of them just disappearing, *a simple poof cloud* or *pixels distorting and fading like a game* or a teleport out animation, also tells you the person didn't block you :P
maybe have a sound that plays as well

I think this would add some fun to the game.
